evidence: Tagged RPC/REST/ZMQ; modifies httpserver.cpp, bitcoin-cli.cpp, and functional RPC tests to support UNIX domain sockets via -rpcbind= and -rpcconnect=.
rationale: Adds long-requested UNIX domain socket support for local RPC connections and bitcoin-cli, resolving issue #5029 from 2014. This provides meaningful user and ecosystem value by avoiding TCP loopback overhead and enabling standard filesystem permissions for access control.
